PATTERN_ADAPTATION.evidenceAgainst: Technical Context fields (plan-template L21-L37) are builder decisions.

EXISTING_OWNER.description: ASSF planning-task-breakdown package for decomposition discipline.

NATIVE_ADAPTATION.description: Pure ledger of requirements, tasks and validations with exact links and dependency checks.

statusResolution.resolution: Registry and front door carry the later ACTIVE lifecycle, SKILL.md the earlier APPROVED header; both state advisory authority and production-scoped receipt-backed use only. No package is activated by this task and no status is treated as consumer integration or runtime availability.

compatibilityFindings: The slice adds files only; the nine named runtime owners and the existing review tests stay byte-identical by git blob, so frozen v1 candidate controls LG1-LG3 cannot change by construction.

The evaluator takes the review state and the saved-file hash as caller input and cannot verify they belong together; production wiring must derive both from the same bytes accepted through prepareIntentSpecAcceptance. Reopen does not revalidate (T1D evidence), so this is a stated limit, not solved here.
Vietnamese labels in the new module need the existing Text Encoding Exception header convention used by intent-spec-review.ts line 1.

noGoOrBlocker.disposition: No source or authority gap prevents an implementation-ready contract for the evaluator. Unresolved and conditional items: builder-return fit (runtime candidate, UNPROVEN), human UX, production byte-to-state wiring, default test collection (UNVERIFIED).
